row: Little Spark Big Impact is THE podcast to listen to for pediatric physical therapists and physical therapist assistants! Join co-hosts Mica Mitchell, PT, DPT and Joe Schreiber, PT, PhD, FAPTA, on a journey to empower YOU, the pediatric provider!
